title: Retire ROADMAP.md once every issue migrated from it is closed

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

body:
Retire `ROADMAP.md` (delete it from the tree; its history stays in git: `git show <tag>:ROADMAP.md`) once nothing still points to it.

**Blocked until every issue migrated from it is closed.** These carry a `Source: ROADMAP.md …` line:

**Done means:**
- every issue above is closed (fixed, won't-do with a reason, or already done)
- `ROADMAP.md` is removed; `AGENTS.md` (Issue Law) and `CHANGELOG.md` stop referring to it
- `RECOMMENDED.md` stays (the decision log)

Precedent: `DONE.md` was retired the same way in b6c39e6.
